answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a fixed per-address stake bond: an agent must lock tokens before registering an identity that can vote or claim rewards, so forging N fake addresses costs N times the single bond. Detected collusion slashes the deposit, turning each puppet into a sunk cost. Every duplicate pays the same toll, so a ripple of forged identities is pointless while one honest kernel recovers its stake intact, and the treasury can raise the bond until a fake zenith of identities costs more than any extractable reward.
